articles.description: The Dodgers are going to take a “business as usual” approach to the offseason, but Brandon Gomes touched on a couple of topics.
articles.title: Dodgers’ Brandon Gomes shares updates on Tarik Skubal, Shoki Oda, Josue De Paula and more

articles.description: The Dodgers hire Pedro Guerrero, who spent two seasons as the Miami Marlins hitting coach, before the team decided not to retain him for the 2027 season.
articles.title: Dodgers hire former Marlins coach Pedro Guerrero as new hitting instructor
